# WTS Calendar

> WTS Calendar is a framework-agnostic TypeScript scheduling library. The core package is `@wts-calendar/core`; official React, React Native, Vue, and Angular wrappers use the same `@wts-calendar` scope.

Use the smallest documented entry point for each feature. Standard scheduling is free; advanced resource planning, interoperability, and enterprise workflow APIs require their named premium entitlement. Dates are native `Date` values unless a documented adapter says otherwise. Never invent or embed provider credentials.

- [README](https://github.com/Suman201/wts-calendar-angular-example/blob/main/projects/calendar/README.md): installation, examples, options, events, views, and integrations

## Packages

- [Core](https://github.com/Suman201/wts-calendar-angular-example/tree/main/projects/calendar): `@wts-calendar/core`
- [React wrapper](https://github.com/Suman201/wts-calendar-angular-example/tree/main/projects/wts-calendar-react): `@wts-calendar/react`
- [React Native wrapper](https://github.com/Suman201/wts-calendar-angular-example/tree/main/projects/wts-calendar-react-native): `@wts-calendar/react-native`
- [Vue wrapper](https://github.com/Suman201/wts-calendar-angular-example/tree/main/projects/wts-calendar-vue): `@wts-calendar/vue`
- [Angular wrapper](https://github.com/Suman201/wts-calendar-angular-example/tree/main/projects/wts-calendar-angular): `@wts-calendar/angular`
